sentences.span: RTY is now 11% below its peak and in a correction
sentences.why: JPM afternoon briefing states the exact correction/11%-below-peak fact; the point levels (NDX -202bps to 29,950, RTY -193bps to 2,729) are independently confirmed verbatim in GS Milhous (20332) and GS Equities Color (20328).

sentences.span: the broader issue is whether the cost and availability of capital become prohibitive for lower quality borrowers
sentences.why: Opinion-shaped bridging sentence into the CCC-spread story; its stance (damage concentrated among borrowers exposed to rising cost of capital) is the bank's own framing in this note.

sentences.span: CCC spreads around 1,250bp, over 200bp wider since September, while BB and single B have had very less dramatic widening
sentences.why: Figure and widening-since-September detail match exactly; 'idiosyncratic distress in legacy media, cable and building products' and 'not necessarily convinced AI crowding out is driving CCC weakness' support the 'one-off... rather than anything about computing' framing.

sentences.span: The winners remain those who control scarce compute and scarce capacity
sentences.why: Matches 'owners of scarce compute and scarce capacity to win'; 'I remain fundamentally bullish on the technology' in the same note supports 'stays bullish on the technology itself'.

sentences.span: If credit stress broadens, the implications extend well beyond AI to SMEs, consumers and the broader economy
sentences.why: SMEs/consumers/economy framing matches exactly; 'a few in the AI vertical with notable increases in CDS that we should be watching' supports the default-insurance clause (CDS = cost of default insurance).

sentences.span: Core goods inflation rose 0.25% m/m, more than triple its 0.07% three-month average
third rate hike in March 2027 after rate hikes in September and December 2026
sentences.why: UBS's third-hike call (Sep/Dec 2026 + Mar 2027) is verbatim in this note, and GS/JPM's 'second hike in December' call is independently confirmed (20328, 20335, 20404, 20406). But 'against market pricing of nearly five in total' has no support anywhere in the day's corpus: the only market-pricing figures found are a 90%->150% probability framing for a possible 50bp December hike (20259), 50% October / 1x December OIS pricing (20406), and a separate note's 'market expectations: 3 rate hikes by June 2027' (20254) — none state or imply a cumulative total near five hikes priced by the market. The sentence rests on real sourced bank calls but tacks on a specific quantitative market-pricing figure invented beyond them.

sentences.span: CPI (MoM) +0.65% for September vs. GS +0.59%, median forecast +0.6%
sentences.why: Verbatim match on all three figures.

sentences.span: energy contributing nearly 40bps to the 65bps monthly gain
Higher oil and jet fuel costs also continued to feed through to travel-related categories, with airfare inflation rising 1.2% m/m
sentences.why: Verbatim match, same sentence/paragraph as s9's source.

sentences.span: FM and RM were better buyers of USTs across the curve
sentences.why: FM/RM is desk shorthand for fast money / real money accounts (permitted expansion); preceding text ('risk started to bleed, we saw growth fear type price action and a flight to quality into USTs') supports 'as stocks sold off'.

sentences.span: Quality has been strongly negatively correlated to the AI trade, momentum or beta trades
sentences.why: Matches the negative-correlation framing; 'We continue to favor quality (GSP1QUAL), Defensives over Cyclicals (short GSPUCYDE), and like shorting long duration pockets like Low Quality Equities (GSXULOWQ), which offers a cleaner rates expression' matches the rest of the sentence exactly.

sentences.span: Joe out upgrading TT to Buy, LII and CARR downgrade to Neutral
sentences.why: Verbatim match (TT/LII/CARR tickers, same ratings actions).

sentences.span: we expect semiconductor profits alone to account for about half of S&P 500 earnings growth in the third quarter
sentences.why: 28% EPS growth figure is verbatim ('we forecast earnings per share growth of 28% for the September quarter') in the same paragraph; corroborated by UBS's companion note (20391) which gives 'S&P 500 earnings growth of around 28%'.
